# HRAS v20 Conformance and Adversarial Test Suite

**Status:** PROPOSED_NOT_EXECUTED. All 139 cases are NOT_RUN; real environments and content-addressed fixtures are not provisioned. This file is rendered from `HRAS_v20_Test_Cases.json`.

## Execution prerequisites

- Provision the case-specific `environment_profile_ref`; set `environment_id` only after a real instance exists.
- Materialize fixture and verify `fixture_declaration_hash`; then calculate `fixture_hash` over actual bytes, bind the case to environment identity, freeze it and recalculate `case_hash`.
- Freeze the test-specific oracle and independently approve threshold before execution.
- The trusted adapter must emit a `TestObservationEnvelope`; the agent under test cannot self-certify results.
- Runtime/adversarial cases use the bounded trial policy defined per case.
- An unmaterialized fixture has null `fixture_hash` and null `environment_id`, so its status cannot be PASS.

**Requirement-reference semantics:** `requirement_refs` maps a case to canonical requirements in the active spec (`HRAS-Rnnn`). `source_requirement_refs` preserves its origin reference; it may use the same `HRAS-Rnnn` only when the active spec itself is the origin, otherwise it MUST use `<source-artifact-id>@<version>::<local-requirement-id>`. This preserves source provenance without merging it with coverage mapping.
